method: Loaded saved NPZ probabilities/predictions/edge_costs and frozen development evaluation caches. Reimplemented Viterbi recurrence independently for both cost-3 and time-varying H/A costs; checked saved candidate emissions equal baseline emissions; recomputed per-cell official development metrics and spell diagnostics from saved predictions; recomputed per-provider/per-view and equal-provider means independently.
scope: Independent replay of saved predictions and scorer only; no model inference, refitting, public labels, or organizer gate.
